task: Refresh Phase 25.1 R0 compatibility counts at the accepted R1 baseline
observation: Combining the source-free corpus with R0 surface probes made the oracle reuse generic-map-index-mutation as a filesystem case ID and abort with FileExistsError. Two negative/control corpus rows also have no expected_output, so their successful source and ABI-v9 runs were mislabeled output-mismatch. Assigning a temporary distinct ID let the exact 19-case R0 slice complete without changing compiler or harness code.
impact: The checked-in combined-inventory command cannot currently produce an unambiguous complete R0 report; raw status totals otherwise mix a distinct Map-parameter profile with the local Map profile and intentional fail-closed controls.

resolution.summary: The refreshed evidence uses a temporary unique suffix for the duplicate surface Map-parameter case and reports negative-control rows separately. R2 WP4 tracks stable IDs, explicit expectations, and a combined-inventory runner test.

task: Promote the surface Map mutation probe from expected unavailable to required ABI-v10 support
observation: When the common checked-body producer began admitting the Map-parameter mutation, the surface probe still declared SOURCE_FREE_CHECKED_BODY_UNAVAILABLE as an expected result. The oracle therefore would have classified a regression back to provider or consumer failure as valid-but-unavailable-v10. Removing those stale expectations and requiring provider_must_emit_v10 made the same source-free Debug/Release path mandatory; margo build now runs without projection-trace stderr, and a separate traced moss check records projection.
impact: The compatibility oracle now fails if ABI-v10 provider emission or consumer admission regresses, while keeping projection evidence observable without turning trace output into a build failure.
evidence: tests/phase25/compatibility/oracle.py: consumer build and traced check stages

resolution.summary: The corrected surface Map oracle passes source-backed, ABI-v9, and source-deleted ABI-v10 Debug/Release with zero unexpected results; independent architect rerun confirms provider emission is required.
